method: Manual evaluation against the rubric committed before inference; no automatic keyword scoring
scope: Three text-only synthetic probes per model, one greedy generation each. This is not an estimate of medical accuracy or multimodal performance.

thalamus.reported: 40%, 9%, RR 4.44; the displayed 8100/9000 also does not equal 9%
thalamus.confounder_recognition: Identifies catabolic illness as a common cause and distinguishes it from a mediator
thalamus.intervention_conclusion: Ambiguous: says the result appears to identify a benefit before naming confounding, and adds an unsupported Cholesterol -> Mortality arrow

qwen.reported: 4.4%, 0.9%, RR about 4.9; displayed fractions contradict the percentages and the supplied cohort
qwen.confounder_recognition: Correct common-cause graph and within-stratum risk ratios of 1
qwen.intervention_conclusion: Explicitly rejects causal benefit from the observational association

hormesis.reference: Do not select a human dose or infer an optimum from two concentrations; require exposure and outcome measurements

thalamus.surrogate_conflict: Recognizes reduced marker alongside impaired survival
thalamus.additional_observation: Treats off-target toxicity as a possibility, rather than an established mechanism

qwen.surrogate_conflict: Recognizes reduced marker alongside impaired survival
qwen.additional_observation: Overreach: claims a 1-100 micromolar therapeutic window and a redox-homeostasis mechanism that the two observations do not establish

reference.interpretation: Converted efficacy dose only; no NOAEL or validated human exposure model supplied

thalamus.safe_starting_dose_claim: Disclaims establishing a safe starting dose or efficacy probability, but incorrectly describes scaling as comparable human exposure
thalamus.next_step: Proposes a proof-of-concept trial in an appropriate human model without first resolving the missing toxicology; wording does not specify whether that model is in vitro or clinical

qwen.safe_starting_dose_claim: Correctly separates efficacy dose from NOAEL and rejects an efficacy probability
qwen.next_step: Prematurely calls a healthy-volunteer phase I trial the next experiment and implies non-human primate NOAEL studies are universally required; the supplied prompt does not justify that prescription
